project.description:
Stages one HPDS variant of a pheno dataset into the stack bucket as data/<destination_bucket_hash>/... Triggered by Check For Updates (once per variant).
HPDS_VARIANT: auth -> javabins_rekeyed/ (legacy tar javabins_rekeyed.tar), open -> destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed/ (legacy tar destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed.tar, concepts removed).
source_s3_url: - ends with .tar: legacy path (assume curated-datasets-s3-role, download, open: RemoveConceptFromMetadata in docker, re-tar, upload). - dataset prefix (ends with /, has manifest.json schema bdc-hpds-pheno-release/1): per-file staging. Server-side copies of the variant's files with the instance role (no assume_role, no docker), byte check of every copy, metadata.json also copied to fence_mapping.json, manifest.tsv written last. Refuses: unknown variant, bad manifest, open variant with the full columnMeta (stored sha or, when present, the gunzipped content sha of full and open is equal), a stage prefix that already has manifest.tsv. A run that died before manifest.tsv can be retried.
IAM the instance role of this Jenkins needs for the dataset-prefix path (granted by Thomas, not by this job): - source bucket (bdc-etl-data-d0d6191): s3:ListBucket (prefix data/hpds/pheno/datasets/*) and s3:GetObject on data/hpds/pheno/datasets/* - stack bucket (stack_s3_bucket): s3:ListBucket (prefix data/*), s3:GetObject and s3:PutObject on data/* (SSE-S3, no KMS) The legacy .tar path keeps using curated-datasets-s3-role.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: source_s3_url
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: .tar object (legacy) or dataset prefix ending with /

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: HPDS_VARIANT
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: auth stages javabins_rekeyed/, open stages destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed/

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: destination_bucket_hash
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: the git hash of the commit that changed the data set

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash # shellcheck disable=SC2154 # stack_s3_bucket, source_s3_url, ... are provided by Jenkins set -e
# Stages one HPDS variant (HPDS_VARIANT = auth|open) of a pheno dataset into the stack bucket. # source_s3_url ends with .tar -> legacy path: download the tar, (open: remove concepts), re-tar, upload. # source_s3_url is a dataset prefix (ends with /) -> per-file staging driven by its manifest.json. # Contract: bdc-hpds-pheno-release/1 (manifest.json) and bdc-hpds-deploy/1 (manifest.tsv).
refuse() { echo "REFUSED: $*" >&2 exit 1 }
case "${HPDS_VARIANT}" in auth) stage_prefix="javabins_rekeyed/" legacy_name="javabins_rekeyed" remove_concepts=false ;; open) stage_prefix="destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed/" legacy_name="destigmatized_javabins_rekeyed" remove_concepts=true ;; *) refuse "unknown HPDS_VARIANT '${HPDS_VARIANT}' (expected auth or open)" ;; esac
source_s3_url="$(printf '%s' "${source_s3_url}" | tr -d '[:space:]')" destination_bucket_hash="$(printf '%s' "${destination_bucket_hash}" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
[[ "${source_s3_url}" =~ ^s3://[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*/[A-Za-z0-9._/=+%:-]+$ ]] || refuse "source_s3_url '${source_s3_url}' is not an s3:// object or prefix URL" [[ "${destination_bucket_hash}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]] || refuse "destination_bucket_hash '${destination_bucket_hash}' is not a git hash" [ -n "${stack_s3_bucket}" ] || refuse "stack_s3_bucket is not set"
if [[ "${source_s3_url}" == *.tar ]]; then install_path=legacy elif [[ "${source_s3_url}" == */ ]]; then install_path=dataset else refuse "source_s3_url must end with .tar (legacy) or / (dataset prefix)" fi
stage_key_prefix="data/${destination_bucket_hash}/${stage_prefix}"
sha256_of() { if command -v sha256sum > /dev/null 2>&1; then sha256sum "$1" | cut -d ' ' -f 1 else shasum -a 256 "$1" | cut -d ' ' -f 1 fi }
# ListBucket on data/* is granted while HeadObject on a missing key may answer 403, so list first. key_exists() { local bucket="$1" key="$2" out if out=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "${bucket}" --prefix "${key}" --output json 2> /dev/null); then # jq 1.6 -e exits 0 on empty input: an empty listing must mean "not there" [ -n "${out}" ] || return 1 printf '%s' "${out}" | jq -e --arg k "${key}" 'any(.Contents[]?; .Key == $k)' > /dev/null else aws s3api head-object --bucket "${bucket}" --key "${key}" > /dev/null 2>&1 fi }
if [ "${install_path}" = "dataset" ]; then ### Per-file staging from a dataset prefix. One identity (the instance role); no docker. # Needs (granted by Thomas, see the job description): # source bucket: s3:ListBucket + s3:GetObject on data/hpds/pheno/datasets/* # stack bucket: s3:ListBucket + s3:GetObject + s3:PutObject on data/* if key_exists "${stack_s3_bucket}" "${stage_key_prefix}manifest.tsv"; then refuse "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${stage_key_prefix}manifest.tsv already exists; staged prefixes are immutable" fi
work=dataset_work rm -rf "${work}" mkdir -p "${work}"
aws s3 cp "${source_s3_url}manifest.json" "${work}/manifest.json" --only-show-errors \ || refuse "cannot read ${source_s3_url}manifest.json (not a released dataset prefix?)" # jq 1.6 -e exits 0 on empty input, so the checks below need a non-empty file [ -s "${work}/manifest.json" ] || refuse "${source_s3_url}manifest.json is empty"
jq -e --arg v "${HPDS_VARIANT}" ' def okpath: type == "string" and test("^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$") and (startswith("/") | not) and (endswith("/") | not) and (test("//") | not) and (test("(^|/)\\.{1,2}(/|$)") | not); .schema == "bdc-hpds-pheno-release/1" and (.dataset_id | type == "string" and test("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{4}Z$")) and (.variants[$v] | type == "array" and length > 0) and all(.variants[$v][]; (.src | okpath) and (.dest | okpath) and (.bytes | type == "number" and . >= 0 and . == floor) and (.sha256 == null or (.sha256 | type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{64}$"))) and (.etag == null or (.etag | type == "string" and test("^[!-~]*$")))) and ([.variants[$v][].dest] | length) == ([.variants[$v][].dest] | unique | length) and any(.variants[$v][]; .dest == "metadata.json") and any(.variants[$v][]; .dest == "columnMeta.javabin") ' "${work}/manifest.json" > /dev/null || refuse "manifest.json is not a valid bdc-hpds-pheno-release/1 manifest with a usable '${HPDS_VARIANT}' variant"
if [ "${HPDS_VARIANT}" = "open" ]; then jq -e ' (.removal.open_columnmeta_sha256 | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.removal.full_columnmeta_sha256 | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.removal.open_columnmeta_sha256 != .removal.full_columnmeta_sha256) and (((.removal.full_columnmeta_content_sha256 | type) == "string" and (.removal.open_columnmeta_content_sha256 | type) == "string" and .removal.full_columnmeta_content_sha256 == .removal.open_columnmeta_content_sha256) | not) and all(.variants.open[] | select(.dest == "columnMeta.javabin"); .src != "columnMeta.javabin") ' "${work}/manifest.json" > /dev/null || refuse "open variant would ship the full columnMeta.javabin (concepts were not removed, or full and open columnMeta contents are identical)" else jq -e 'all(.variants.auth[]; (.src | startswith("open/")) | not)' "${work}/manifest.json" > /dev/null \ || refuse "auth variant must not use files from open/" fi
dataset_id="$(jq -r '.dataset_id' "${work}/manifest.json")" manifest_sha="$(sha256_of "${work}/manifest.json")"
{ echo "# bdc-hpds-deploy/1" echo "# variant=${HPDS_VARIANT}" echo "# dataset_id=${dataset_id}" echo "# source=${source_s3_url}" echo "# manifest_sha256=${manifest_sha}" printf 'dest\tbytes\tsha256\tetag\tsrc\n' } > "${work}/manifest.tsv"
jq -r --arg v "${HPDS_VARIANT}" '.variants[$v][] | [.src, .dest, (.bytes | tostring), (.sha256 // "-"), (.etag // "-")] | @tsv' \ "${work}/manifest.json" > "${work}/entries.tsv"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r e_src e_dest e_bytes e_sha e_etag; do echo "staging ${e_src} -> ${e_dest} (${e_bytes} bytes)" # Every aws call in this loop reads /dev/null: the loop reads entries.tsv on stdin and a CLI that reads stdin would end it early. aws s3 cp "${source_s3_url}${e_src}" "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${stage_key_prefix}${e_dest}" --sse AES256 --only-show-errors < /dev/null head_json="$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "${stack_s3_bucket}" --key "${stage_key_prefix}${e_dest}" < /dev/null)" got_bytes="$(printf '%s' "${head_json}" | jq -r '.ContentLength')" [ "${got_bytes}" = "${e_bytes}" ] || refuse "${e_dest}: staged ${got_bytes} bytes, manifest says ${e_bytes}" printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "${e_dest}" "${e_bytes}" "${e_sha}" "${e_etag}" "${e_src}" >> "${work}/manifest.tsv" if [ "${e_dest}" = "metadata.json" ]; then aws s3 cp "${source_s3_url}${e_src}" "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/data/${destination_bucket_hash}/fence_mapping.json" --sse AES256 --only-show-errors < /dev/null fi done < "${work}/entries.tsv"
# Never publish a manifest.tsv that lists fewer files than the variant has. expected_rows="$(jq -r --arg v "${HPDS_VARIANT}" '.variants[$v] | length' "${work}/manifest.json")" written_rows="$(tail -n +7 "${work}/manifest.tsv" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" [ "${written_rows}" = "${expected_rows}" ] || refuse "manifest.tsv has ${written_rows} data rows, the ${HPDS_VARIANT} variant has ${expected_rows} entries; not uploading it"
# manifest.tsv last: its presence marks the stage prefix complete and immutable. aws s3 cp "${work}/manifest.tsv" "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${stage_key_prefix}manifest.tsv" --sse AES256 --only-show-errors < /dev/null echo "Staged ${HPDS_VARIANT} from ${source_s3_url} (dataset ${dataset_id}) to s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${stage_key_prefix}" exit 0 fi
### Legacy .tar path (unchanged behaviour; output name and concept removal derive from the variant). curated_datasets_s3_role="arn:aws:iam::515157839325:role/curated-datasets-s3-role"
# Source folder containing the scripts source_scripts_folder="${JENKINS_HOME}/workspace/Bash_Functions/" ls -la "$source_scripts_folder"
# Iterate through the files in the folder and source them for script_file in "$source_scripts_folder"*.sh; do chmod +x "$script_file" if [ -f "$script_file" ] && [ -x "$script_file" ]; then echo "sourcing $script_file" # shellcheck source=/dev/null source "$script_file" fi done
mkdir -p local/hpds/ mkdir -p local/source/
if [ "${remove_concepts}" = "true" ]; then stack=$(get_stack "staging")
### Build ETL Image aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/${stack}/containers/pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz" pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz --no-progress
HPDS_ETL_IMAGE=$(docker load < ./pic-sure-hpds-etl.tar.gz | cut -d ' ' -f 3) echo "$HPDS_ETL_IMAGE" ls -alh "$(pwd)" fi
### Pull data set to rekey. if [ -n "${curated_datasets_s3_role}" ]; then assume_role "${curated_datasets_s3_role}" fi
aws s3 cp "${source_s3_url}" local/source/javabins.tar --no-progress
### Try extracting as compressed tar if tar -xzvf local/source/javabins.tar -C local/source; then echo "Extracted compressed tar file." else echo "Compressed extraction failed, trying non-compressed..." if tar -xvf local/source/javabins.tar -C local/source; then echo "Extracted non-compressed tar file." else echo "Error: Extraction failed for both compressed and non-compressed tar files." exit 1 fi fi
if [ -n "${curated_datasets_s3_role}" ]; then reset_role fi
# For caution replicate data into local/hpds as the loader used to write there. cp -r local/source/* local/hpds/
### Open variant: remove concepts if [ "${remove_concepts}" = "true" ]; then # RemoveConceptFromMetadata reads the data set in /opt/local/hpds. # add concepts to remove to /opt/local/hpds that contains the list of concepts to destigmatize cp local/source/conceptsToRemove.txt local/hpds/ docker run -e HEAPSIZE=20480 -e JAVA_OPTS="-Xms4g" -i -v "${WORKSPACE}"/local:/opt/local:Z -e LOADER_NAME=RemoveConceptFromMetadata "$HPDS_ETL_IMAGE" fi
cd "$WORKSPACE"/local/hpds/
# Leave the data set artifact as non-compressed for the rest of it's lifecycle tar -cvf "${legacy_name}.tar" -- *.javabin encryption_key metadata.json
aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp "${legacy_name}.tar" "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/data/${destination_bucket_hash}/${legacy_name}.tar" --quiet aws s3 --sse=AES256 cp metadata.json "s3://${stack_s3_bucket}/data/${destination_bucket_hash}/fence_mapping.json"
